usageNotes: Triggers an `apt-get update` on the specified PBS remote node, refreshing the local package index so that pending upgrades become visible via the APT changelog/versions endpoints. The operation is asynchronous — it returns a remote UPID string that must be polled for completion. The caller must hold `Resource.Modify` on the remote+node+system path, and the remote node must be reachable from PDM at the time of the call.

examples.summary: Refresh the APT package index on node 'pbs-node1' of the remote named 'hetzner-pbs'

tips: No request body parameters are required — send an empty JSON object ({}) as the body.
The returned UPID is a remote UPID (≥42 chars); use the corresponding task-status endpoint scoped to the same remote+node to poll for completion before querying available upgrades.
Remote name must be 2–32 characters and match the pattern [A-Za-z0-9_][A-Za-z0-9._-]* — simple alphanumeric names with hyphens or underscores are safe.
This only refreshes the package index; it does not install or upgrade any packages.
